name: halloween-town
author: Lil Art
description: A Halloween instance in a haunted, night-time Niflheim, solo or with your party. Talk to Casper in Niflheim (185, 190), pick a moon (Blue Moon for 90+, Blood Moon for 100-199, Eclipse for 200+), and stop Blair the witch across three hordes and four bosses within 90 minutes. Every kill pays Halloween Coins, which Jakk (180, 191) trades for costumes, boxes and a Sealed Card Album; Blair's tickets trade for Cash Points. Blue Moon works on Pre-renewal too.
